findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation drops every diagnostic whose location is not in source of the current compilation. Diagnostics created with a null Location (Diagnostic.Create with null location gives Location.None, IsInSource false) are now silently suppressed. This includes MemberNeedsKey and BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull for metadata members, but also any other analyzer diagnostic with no source location. Those diagnostics warn about insecure or incorrect configurations, so the filter is broader than the crash fix needs. The impact is limited, because metadata types are reported by their own compilation, so this is a low-severity hunch.

receipt_plan.detail: Read every this.reportDiagnostic?.Invoke call in TypeCollector.cs and list those that pass a Location of null or Location.None. Check whether any of them are for security-relevant diagnostics, for example a diagnostic about a missing or unsafe formatter configuration, that previously surfaced and are now dropped.
